ftab02_scope_conflict.interpretation: The exact whole-Hupsel authority is now available, but the admitted M1-C3 constitutive profile lies outside the frozen F-TAB02 generated-provider parameter envelope. Executing a generated-provider whole-Hupsel comparison would require widening F-TAB02 to represent the F-SI39 KSATEXM extension, which is not authorized by the current preregistration.

stop_condition_binding.action: Do not add KSATEXM support inside F-TAB02-F. Open a separately preregistered research/qualification slice if KSATEXM-equivalent generated acceleration is desired.

resume_condition: A separately authorized KSATEXM-equivalent generated-provider representation is researched and qualified, or an independently authorized exact whole-application gate inside the existing non-KSATEXM F-TAB02 parameter envelope is established. The exact archive asset is no longer the blocker.
